channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: Classic r10 adds RX-only defaults for new/copied channels and changed transmit frequencies outside the amateur bands. Turning RX-only off requires an explicit Enable TX confirmation in the firmware and matching Classic CPS. Existing RFKV programming is preserved; the independent P25 transmit-band restriction is unchanged. RFKV programming only: retired Classic formats are not imported. The application-only package uses the radio’s own DMR codec and preserves the bootloader and data chip during flashing. Full host software, sanitizer, browser, target stack/ABI, warning and identical forced-rebuild checks passed. Physical-radio qualification of this release has not been performed. Known issues: PL/CTCSS can drop during DTMF, and an intermittent P25 PTT startup with no RF remains under investigation. Save a full backup before installing.
